title: AG69020: Farm Machinery Testing Laboratory
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Testing of agricultural implements. Performance evaluation of tractor and power
tiller drawn tillage, seeding, weeding, plant protection, harvesting and
threshing machines. Testing of animal drawn and manually drawn operated
implements. Testing of crop processing equipments. Test codes of agricultural
machines.
